posts.author: Stephanov
posts.title: [INFO] What is ||VM|| Experiment RP?
posts.edited: Last Edit: August 29, 2009, 08:45:47 AM by Stephanov
posts.html:
||VM|| Experiment RP

It can best be described as an open-ended RP server with very little rules.  You can basically become anything here as long as it doesn't go against the rules.

Every wanted to find out what it's like to have a Legion, Nazi's or I don't know..... Spacemarines?! on one server?

Then Experiment RP is the place for you!

TIPS:

-Stay the fuck away from large factions. Seriously.
-Find a GOOD place to stash contraband. You will most likely get raided or "taxed" otherwise.
-At least try to give newbies a chance. We don't want to drain the server of population.
-Try not to spend your first 5000 on weapons. You'll find that perks are a much more worthwhile investment.
-Make sure that if you see someone break a rule, you NOTIFY A ADMINISTRATOR, not do the same back to the person breakin the rule at you.
-Keep checking the forum for updates on rules, etc.
-Work together with some people. Going solo is the very definition of failure.
-If you have your own faction, you don't have to be at war with someone as a excuse to kill people. You can have "NAP"'s (Non-Aggression Pacts) or alliances!
-Think very carefully of what the repercussions of thieving of someone's body is. The chance is there people will kill you over and over untill you give it back.


The gamemode:

The gamemode is an adaption of the kuroscript gamemode. Made by kuromeku.

Rules:

The rules can be changed at any and all time. Keep checking for updates as ignorance is no excuse.

1) Do not prop kill.
2) Do not prop surf.
3) Only use one layer of prop block per door.
4) Do not kill in public (Do not kill in safe zones?).
5) Do not stat/achievement whore.
6) Do not disconnect to avoid roleplay.


PS: Do not post shit like OMFGLOLEPICGUIDE. The only thing that may be posted here  is content that hadn't come to my attention yet.
